results.overview: A look at the community surrounding Nintendo's New York store in the month leading up to the launch of the Nintendo Switch in 2017.

results.title: Cinderella of Samba
results.overview: Célio, a regular at samba circles, falls in love with a beautiful and mysterious woman who is always singing at the edge of the circle. Every time he tries to approach her she disappears, always at the same time.

results.title: Once Upon a Time in the Apocalypse
results.original_title: Once Upon a Time in the Apocalypse
results.overview: In the fallout of nuclear war, totalitarian regimes reshape world order. Ernesto is hiding a secret, and when a government inspector shows up at his doorstep, a cat-and-mouse game unfolds — one that can only end in tragedy.

results.title: Dinosaur Hunt
results.overview: A rich family are brought together to a remote island for a reunion, only to learn that their father has been experimenting with dinosaurs in an attempt to find a cure for his disease. This family are forced to work together when the dinosaurs escape.

results.title: Look Out!
results.overview: When the criminal in the neighborhood watch sign escapes, a community is thrown into panic. Only through the power of local paranoia and super-funding the police force can any sense of white upper middle-class normalcy be restored. But can this mad criminal be stopped before he spray-paints the property value off every single family home? LOOK OUT!

results.title: Yesterday the Eye Didn't Sleep
results.overview: In a Bedouin village on the Lebanon–Syria border, a burned truck sets off a hunt for Gamra, blamed for burning her lover’s car. As her cousin searches for her, he accidentally kills a man from a rival clan, sparking a blood feud. His sisters are traded for peace. Will their sacrifice end the violence, or ignite a war across the village?

results.title: Dangerous Games: Roblox and the Metaverse Exposed
results.original_title: Dangerous Games: Roblox and the Metaverse Exposed
results.overview: Follow Alex, Janae, and Katie as they investigate the hidden threats inside online worlds designed for children. After Katie is harassed by a predator on Roblox, the trio uncovers a disturbing network of extremists, predators, and illicit content. As their investigation gains traction, real-world tragedies — including a kidnapping and a mass shooting — underscore the devastating consequences of a system failing to protect its most vulnerable users. Through expert interviews and gripping verité storytelling, the film exposes the gaps in platform regulations and the dangers that continue to slip through the cracks. Blending investigative journalism with compelling visuals, Dangerous Games delivers a wake-up call on the urgent need for accountability in the evolving digital world.

results.title: Waking Up From a Nap on a Long Day of Doing Nothing
results.original_title: Waking Up From a Nap on a Long Day of Doing Nothing
results.overview: With the guidance of his best friend and mystical grandfather, a young painter – anxiously awaiting his first gallery show – embarks on a surreal skateboard odyssey through Portland to discover the true value of his art.

results.overview: Explores the circumstances that led to Brittney Griner playing basketball outside the U.S. despite being one of the best players in the sport, including her harrowing detainment, unwavering determination to secure her freedom, and her advocacy for the release of other wrongful detainees.

results.title: Have a Great Apocalypse
results.overview: It’s an end of the world… and Sean wants to write a book. He doesn’t know why or how, but he sure as hell wants to write the dang thing. However, a big question remains : what about ?

results.title: The Remaining
results.overview: What happens, if you can’t make it to the film festival, despite all your planning?  What if everyone else goes, sees, and experiences everything, and you alone are left out?

results.title: Crisis Actor
results.overview: Fired from her day job, an impulsive actress crashes a support group and spirals into a chaotic night that forces her to face her addiction to drama.

results.title: Rexach. Correr es de Cobardes
results.overview: The film looks back at Rexach’s more than 45-year association with FC Barcelona, from his time as a youth player and first-team footballer to his work as a coach, sporting director, scout and presidential adviser. It focuses on his role in some of the club’s defining periods, particularly his relationship with Johan Cruyff, the success of the Dream Team, and his involvement in the discovery and signing of Lionel Messi.
